description: Local account screen can only use the four native authentication commands, the two fixed task reads, the live sync delta read, the four fixed task writes (create, complete, edit details, delete), the six fixed bulk and order writes (complete, delete, clear dates, set metadata or move a selection; reorder one task), the nine fixed label and saved-filter commands (list, open, create, edit, delete), the six fixed project commands (list, open, create, rename, edit (favorite, archive, description, Display), delete), the thirteen fixed goal commands (list, open, create, edit or archive, reorder, hide or show Goals, list links, link or unlink a project or task, read a task's goal suggestions (with the Coach's by meaning), dismiss one, read a task's milestone, mark, edit or unmark it), the nine fixed season commands (read the current season, start one, add a goal to it, change a goal's tier or target, remove a goal from it, list past seasons, end it and start the next, read and save the primary-goal capacity), the five fixed ritual commands (read the ritual settings and today's Check-in, save the settings, record a finished or skipped ritual with its ratings, read the Weekly review's week, read the Season review's ratings history), the five fixed Coach commands (read the connected AI provider, connect one, disconnect it, test the connection, read the goal status explanations), the Coach chat's documents (upload files to the conversation, remove one), ritual-ready notifications (check and ask for permission, show one), window dragging from the overlay title bar, the five fixed organization commands (move destinations, create, rename and delete a section, move or nest one task), the three attachment commands (list a task's attachments, upload files to a project, save an attachment), the nine connected-calendar commands (events, accounts, show an account's events, show or hide a calendar, resync, disconnect, open and stop the live change stream, open an event in Google Calendar), the three Google sign-in commands (start, await, cancel), Ramble socket tickets and the Ramble batch save, semantic completion feedback (standard haptics), the account settings read and write, the keyboard shortcut preferences read and write, the two read-only search commands (search tasks, Quick Find items), and the two task-link commands (await an accepted task deep link, build a task's shareable https link), and the five Todoist import commands (status, connect in the system browser, run, disconnect, answer the sign-up prompt)
